strategy.summary: Send the ball to the top through the left spinner or right saucer. Build the bonus to 100K. Collect Triple Bonus when its two-shot path is available.

quickInfo.name: Bonus
quickInfo.summary: Lit red rollover buttons advance the end-of-ball bonus from 10K toward 100K.

quickInfo.name: Right eject hole
quickInfo.summary: The upper-right eject hole awards its lit value or lights the named feature shown beside it.

quickInfo.name: Triple Bonus
quickInfo.summary: Collect the Lights Top Center Hole award at the right eject, then put the ball in the top-center hole.

quickInfo.name: Double Bonus
quickInfo.summary: Collect the Lights Double Bonus award at the right eject to double the end-of-ball bonus.

quickInfo.name: Lit spinner
quickInfo.summary: Collect Lights Spinner at the right eject to raise the left spinner from 100 to 1,000 per spin.

steps.text: Plunge to the top. Watch the return from the top-center hole and the upper-right eject.
Repeat the left spinner or send the ball toward the upper-right eject. Use the shot with the safer return.
Let the red rollover buttons advance bonus during top play. Do not chase a small button from an uncontrolled ball.
When Lights Top Center Hole is lit at the right eject, collect it. Then send the ball into the top-center hole.
If that award is not available, collect Double Bonus before a large bonus drains.
modeNotes: Triple Bonus: Collect Lights Top Center Hole at the right eject. Then score the top-center hole to triple the end-of-ball bonus.
Double Bonus: Collect the matching award at the right eject. The game doubles the end-of-ball bonus when the ball drains.

steps.text: After 100K and Triple Bonus are ready, use the safest top return. Do not force the lower-left drop target.

fallback.title: Recovery: Double the built bonus
fallback.when: Recovery pivot: Use this when the top-center hole is rejecting the ball or Triple Bonus is not ready.

steps.text: Send the ball through the left spinner or upper-right eject and let the lit red rollover buttons raise bonus.
Collect Lights Double Bonus at the right eject.
Continue the safer left-spinner or right-side top shot.
Protect the doubled bonus after it reaches a useful value.

alternatives.title: Position play: Lit-spinner scoring
alternatives.when: When trailing, use this distinct scoreboard route: use this when the left spinner is repeatable and the right eject has lit it.

steps.text: Collect Lights Spinner at the right eject.
Repeat the left spinner for 1,000 per spin.
Return to bonus qualification when the spinner feed stops being controlled.

alternatives.title: 50K eject award
alternatives.when: Use this when 50K is lit and the right eject is safer than the multiplier path.

steps.text: Confirm that 50K is lit at the upper-right eject.
Collect the eject award from a controlled shot.
Resume the top route and bonus build.
Score the lit red rollover buttons until base bonus reaches 100K.
Collect Lights Top Center Hole at the right eject.
Score the top-center hole to enable Triple Bonus.
Carry the 3x maximum bonus to the end of the ball.

techniques.name: Top route selection
techniques.instruction: Test the left spinner and right-side top shot. Repeat the route that returns the ball to a flipper.

techniques.name: Lit-award timing
techniques.instruction: Read the upper-right eject lamps before the shot. Take the top-center-hole award before lesser scoring awards when possible.

cautions.issue: The lower-left drop target is the dangerous final target in the five-target bank.
cautions.response: Ignore the bank. Let top-center returns collect the upper targets without a direct lower-left shot.

cautions.issue: The right eject can award a lesser feature when the preferred lamp is not lit.
cautions.response: Read the current award before the shot. Continue safe switch play when the desired award is not ready.

cautions.issue: The outlane posts and Special awards are operator-adjustable.
cautions.response: Check the outlane openings and tournament settings before you risk a large bonus.

strategy.simpleOverview: Pinball builds base bonus to 100K. Collect Lights Top Center Hole at the upper-right eject, then shoot the top-center hole for Triple Bonus and carry the 300K maximum bonus to the end of the ball.
strategy.overview: Pinball builds base bonus to 100K. Build the base through top feeds, take Lights Top Center Hole at the eject, then complete the two-shot path at the top-center hole for Triple Bonus. Preserve the resulting 300K end-of-ball collect; use Lights Spinner only when its left-orbit return is controlled.
